# Mike's Vet Dubai

> Mike's Vet is a full-service veterinary clinic on Hessa Street, Dubai, UAE. Founded by Mike and Camelia O'Hara. Rated 4.8 stars on Google by over 500 pet owners. Open 7 days a week, 9:00 AM to 9:30 PM including public holidays. Phone: +971 4 283 7744.

Mike's Vet provides expert veterinary care for cats and dogs in Dubai. Services include consultations, vaccinations, dental care, soft tissue surgery, orthopaedic surgery (including TPLO for cruciate ligament tears), in-house diagnostics (blood tests, digital X-ray, ultrasound), a fully equipped ICU, spay and neuter, and vet home visits across Dubai. The clinic also runs a rescue and cat adoption programme.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.mikesvet.com): Main clinic page with contact, location, and booking
- [Services](https://www.mikesvet.com/services): Full list of veterinary services

## Services

- [Cat Vet Clinic Dubai](https://www.mikesvet.com/services/cat-care): Specialist cat care including IDEXX diagnostics, Vetscan Imagyst AI parasite testing, spay/neuter, dental, and emergency
- [Dog Vet Clinic Dubai](https://www.mikesvet.com/services/dog-care): Comprehensive dog care including TPLO orthopaedic surgery, ICU, dentals, and vaccinations
- [Orthopaedic Surgery](https://www.mikesvet.com/services/orthopaedic-surgery): TPLO, fracture repair, luxating patella correction, hip dysplasia management
- [Soft Tissue Surgery](https://www.mikesvet.com/services/soft-tissue-surgery): Tumour removal, gastrointestinal surgery, caesarean sections
- [Dental Care](https://www.mikesvet.com/services/dental-care): Scale and polish, extractions, dental X-ray under general anaesthetic
- [Emergency Vet Dubai](https://www.mikesvet.com/services/emergency-vet): In-hours emergency care with oxygen therapy, IV fluids, and surgical capability
- [Vaccinations](https://www.mikesvet.com/services/vaccinations): DHPPi, rabies, Leptospirosis, Bordetella for cats and dogs
- [Vet Home Visits Dubai](https://www.mikesvet.com/services/home-visits): Home visit fee AED 400 + VAT; available across Dubai
